pattern: \bwhy (did|do|are|have) you (stop\w*|paus\w*|wait\w*|sitting|delay\w*|stall\w*|idle)\b|\byou keep (stopping|pausing|waiting|delaying|stalling)\b|\bwhat now\b|\b(is|are) (queued|still running|still building|blocked)\b|\bin the meantime\b|\bwhile (it|that|we) (runs?|builds?|wait\w*|deploys?)\b|\btakes? (a while|(\w+ )?(minutes|hours))\b|\bopen items\b
say: [keep-moving] A wait is never the only thing happening: start any slow build in the background (`run_in_background: true` or `&`) and immediately work on the independent open items while it runs—do not wait for the build to finish first. One blocked item does not block the rest. Any status carries the clock: elapsed, the cap, what happens at the cap. Load the keep-moving skill.

pattern: \b(i )?already (said|told you|approved|answered|confirmed)\b|\bwhy are you asking\b|\bstop asking\b|\bjust do it\b|\bgo ahead\b|\bi (said|told you) (to )?(go|yes|do it|proceed)\b
say: [keep-moving] If the user asked for the outcome, the steps toward it are approved. Ask only when the choice is theirs: money, scope, policy, or something hard to undo. Do not hand back a step you can do. Load the keep-moving skill.

pattern: \b(same|that) (test|command|build|thing|job) (again|over and over|\w+ times)\b|\b(ran|run|running) (it|that|this) (again|\w+ times|over and over|repeatedly)\b|\bfails? the same way\b|\bstop (re)?running\b|\bgoing in circles\b|\bin a loop\b
say: [keep-moving] Running the same command with nothing changed gives the same result. Read the output you have or read the code, write down what each attempt showed, then change the idea. Load the keep-moving skill.

pattern: running in background|started in background|\bsleep\s+[1-9]\d\b|slow:.*\d+\s*(?:s|sec|min)|\btakes? (?:a while|\d+\s*(?:s|sec|min))|#\s*open items\b
say: [keep-moving] A long build is starting or pending while independent open items exist. Run the build in the background (`run_in_background: true` or `&`) and immediately start fixing the open items (e.g. from TODO.md) while the build runs—do not block waiting for the build to finish first. Load the keep-moving skill.
